title: No traffic info and graphs shown for VPN connection interfaces
line: Connected VPNs now show their own download and upload speed and graph in the Networks widget.
explanation: A VPN item in the Networks widget has no device, so the speed tab asked for the statistics of an empty device path and always showed 0 B/s with a flat graph. NetworkManager doesn't tell which interface (tun0 etc.) a VPN created, which is why this stayed open since 2011. The model now looks for the device, other than the one the VPN runs over, that has the VPN's IP addresses, re-checks it when the VPN activates or a device's IP config changes, and routes that device's statistics to the VPN item; the applet polls that device, and hides the speed for VPNs without their own interface instead of showing a fake 0.

commits.message:
applet: show the traffic of the interface a VPN creates

VPN items have no device, so their speed graph always stayed at zero. As
NetworkManager doesn't say which interface a VPN uses, find the device
with the VPN's addresses and show its statistics, or no speed if none.

BUG: 268022

media.caption: Master: the connected Office VPN (traffic on tun0) shows 0 B/s and an empty graph while Ethernet shows its traffic.
With the fix: the VPN shows tun0's own speed (about 0.5-1.2 MiB/s, different from Ethernet's) and its graph.
